note: Three corridors: CETESB for São Paulo Litoral Norte (Ilhabela–Ubatuba); INEA for Rio city beaches; INEA also for Costa Verde (Angra dos Reis, Paraty, Mangaratiba / Ilha Grande bay). IMPORTANT: weekly INEA Angra bulletins (21 praias / 22 pontos as of 2026-09-14) cover mainland Angra only — Abraão and other Ilha Grande beaches are NOT in the current weekly list (last dedicated Ilha Grande bulletin ~2015–2016). Popular island spots (Lopes Mendes, Dois Rios, Palmas, Preta, Mangues, Bananal, Aventureiro, Lagoa Azul) therefore have no live Própria/Imprópria pin. Leste (Contorno) is the mainland INEA point on Av. Vereador Benedito Adelino, not Praia do Leste on the island. Red = Imprópria, orange = Parcial, green = Própria (CONAMA 274/2000 Enterococci). Avoid swimming within 24h of heavy rain and near storm drains. Niterói INEA ocean/bay beaches added (Paraty→Niterói share map).
